title: From Numbers to Meaning: High-Dimensional Embeddings
hook: Tokens are just numbers. How does an AI know that king minus man plus woman equals queen?
mental_model: 3D vector space floating in dark space. Word coordinates shifting live as vector arithmetic (+/-) pulls vectors toward 'Queen'.

loop.plan: Last line flows into the first line: '…how do these vectors talk to each other? Tokens are just numbers…'. The last frame is the same dark star-field with a lone glowing dot, which is the first frame.
loop.bait: Token 9246 returns as a tiny glowing dot hidden inside the Queen vector in Scene 4. Only people who watch twice spot it.

style: Dark space, deep blue and violet, neon cyan and gold accents, clean glowing lines, cinematic slow camera, vertical 9:16, no text baked into the video (captions are added later), no people, no logos.

steps.name: Brief, hook and loop
steps.intro: The promise of the short, the hook and how it loops. Everything else follows from this page.

steps.name: Script
steps.intro: Voice-over lines per scene. First draft from the README beats, tightened for a 45 s loop. Fix wording here first: it is the cheapest place to change.

steps.name: Storyboard
steps.intro: What the viewer sees in each beat: camera, motion and the on-screen text added in the edit.

steps.name: Flow prompts
steps.intro: One prompt per clip. Paste each into Google Flow (no API, so you create them by hand), keep the style line the same on every clip so they match.

steps.name: Generate in Flow
steps.intro: Manual step. Tick each clip when generated and downloaded, and note which take you picked.

steps.name: Voice-over
steps.intro: Record or generate the voice from the S2-01 lines. Calm, curious, a little fast; leave no silence at the end so the loop is tight.

steps.name: Assemble and loop check
steps.intro: Cut the clips to the timings, add the voice and captions, and check the loop and the rewatch bait.

steps.name: Publish and analytics
steps.intro: After posting: read the rewatch numbers and feed them into the next short.

scenes.readme: Token ID 9246 gets passed into a lookup table
scenes.vo: Tokens are just numbers. This one, nine-two-four-six, is a word. But to the AI, it means nothing yet.
scenes.visual: Dark space. A glowing number 9246 drops into a giant glowing table of rows, like a lookup grid. A single dot lights up on its row.
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16, cinematic. In a dark deep-space void, a glowing neon-cyan number '9246' floats down and slots into a huge glowing grid like a lookup table with thousands of rows; one row lights up and a single bright dot emerges. Slow dolly-in, shallow depth of field, tiny floating particles.

scenes.vo: So it gets unfolded. One number becomes fifteen hundred and thirty-six coordinates.
scenes.visual: The single dot splits into streams of glowing numbers that fan out into a 3D coordinate space, axes appearing one after another.
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16. In the same dark space, a single glowing dot bursts into hundreds of thin neon-cyan light streams of tiny numbers that fan out and form a 3D coordinate space with axes multiplying outward into the distance. Camera pulls back smoothly, lines draw themselves, elegant and minimal.

scenes.readme: Semantic clustering: Fruit cluster vs Royalty cluster
scenes.vo: And meaning becomes distance. Apples, pears, grapes gather here. Kings, queens, crowns, over there.
scenes.visual: Hundreds of dots drift and settle into two clusters: warm orange-red fruit dots on the left, gold royal dots on the right, with empty space between.
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16. In the dark 3D vector space, hundreds of small glowing dots drift and settle into two separate clusters: warm orange and red dots on the lower left, shining gold dots on the upper right, a wide empty gap between them. Slow orbiting camera, soft glow, cinematic.

scenes.readme: The King - Man + Woman = Queen vector math live
scenes.vo: Now watch. Take king. Subtract man. Add woman.
scenes.visual: Inside the royalty cluster the dot 'King' glows. An arrow for 'Man' pulls it back, an arrow for 'Woman' pushes it forward.
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16. In the dark vector space, a glowing gold dot labelled with a crown glow sits in a cluster. A cyan arrow pulls it backward, then a magenta arrow pushes it forward along a curved path through space, leaving a bright trail. Slow tracking camera follows the dot, minimal clean vector-arrow style.

scenes.readme: The King - Man + Woman = Queen vector math live (payoff)
scenes.vo: And you land exactly on queen. No one told it. It's just geometry.
scenes.visual: The moving dot lands on a brighter gold dot: Queen. A ring pulses. Hidden inside the dot, a tiny glowing 9246 (rewatch bait).
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16. The glowing gold dot arrives at a larger brighter gold dot and locks in with a satisfying pulse ring of light; a soft shockwave ripples through the particles. Inside the bright dot a very tiny glowing cyan number is faintly visible. Camera slowly pushes in, then holds, dramatic and clean.

scenes.readme: Teaser: How do these vectors talk to each other?
scenes.vo: But how do these vectors talk to each other?
scenes.visual: Glowing threads begin to connect distant dots, then everything fades back to the first frame: dark space and one lone dot.
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16. Thin glowing threads of light begin to connect distant dots across the vector space, hinting at a network, then the camera pulls back and everything fades until only a dark star-field with one lone softly glowing cyan dot remains in the exact center. Smooth, calm, seamless loop-friendly ending.

metadata.title: How AI Knows King − Man + Woman = Queen 🤯 #shorts
metadata.description: Tokens are just numbers. So how does an AI know that king minus man plus woman equals queen? In 45 seconds: embeddings turn one number into 1,536 coordinates, and meaning becomes distance. Day 2 of the series, the sequel to Day 1 (tokens). Next: how do these vectors talk to each other? 👀
